bicubic.description: scipy.interpolate.RectBivariateSpline with kx=ky=3 and s=0: FITPACK knot placement, tensor-product coefficients and values at the nodes, at cell centres and beyond every side, for grids from the 4x4 minimum up to SUAVE's own 10x8 surrogate training grid

bspline.description: CasADi's 1-D 'bspline' interpolant, with SciPy's not-a-knot knot vector and coefficients for the same data as a structural check; includes the altitude grid AeroSandbox's default atmosphere uses

chebyshev.description: SUAVE chebyshev_data: cosine-spaced nodes and the D/I pseudospectral operators

spline.description: scipy.interpolate.CubicSpline: every combination of a first- or second-derivative boundary condition at each end, for a scalar and a 2-D dataset, evaluated at the knots and beyond both ends
